name: seeing-stone
author: Seeing Stone contributors
description: Seeing Stone — a Windows-first, local-first Jellyfin client.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.package:mpv-spike: pnpm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-mpv-package.ps1
scripts.package:windows: pnpm run setup:mpv && pnpm run build && pnpm run generate:worker-integrity && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:windows:dir: pnpm run setup:mpv && pnpm run build && pnpm run generate:worker-integrity && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:electron && pnpm run test:persistence-runtime && pnpm run test:media-probe
scripts.test:core: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:main && node --test tests-node/*.test.cjs
scripts.test:embedded-integrated-smoke: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer && electron scripts/embedded-video-smoke.cjs --integrated
scripts.test:embedded-overlay-smoke: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer && electron scripts/embedded-video-smoke.cjs --overlay
scripts.test:embedded-fullscreen-smoke: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer && electron scripts/embedded-video-smoke.cjs --fullscreen
scripts.test:gate-6: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run licenses:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:electron && pnpm run test:persistence-runtime && pnpm run test:media-probe && pnpm run test:gate-6-runtime && pnpm run test:gate-6-visual
scripts.test:gate-5: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run licenses:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:electron && pnpm run test:persistence-runtime && pnpm run test:gate-5-visual
scripts.test:gate-3-4: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run licenses:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:electron && pnpm run test:persistence-runtime && pnpm run test:media-probe && pnpm run test:mpv-runtime && pnpm run test:mpv-completion && pnpm run test:player-shell-visual
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
